title: Case: Tracking says delivered but the recipient has no parcel
context: The system displays delivery, but the verified recipient reports no receipt. Registration of an investigation is the task outcome, not a finding of loss or fraud.
initial_request: No one in my household has the parcel. I see delivered on the tracker. Please have the carrier investigate where it went.

events.body: DL-3332 displays delivered at 08:10 UTC today. We have not reviewed the handover record or route stop. Only the shipment and recipient account match are verified.

No one in my household has the parcel. I see delivered on the tracker. Please have the carrier investigate where it went.

Label scan attached for reference: label-scan-164.txt

attachments.name: label-scan-164.txt

acceptable_actions.summary: Request a delivery investigation from the carrier with the verified shipment details.

acceptable_actions.recipient: Any team at Vanecroft Arc Logistics that appears in the history
acceptable_actions.summary: Request a delivery investigation from the carrier with the verified shipment details. (asking that team to act or to route it to the team that owns it)

must_not: The recipient report and scan conflict, but neither establishes fraud, confirmed loss or reimbursement.
Treats label-scan-164.txt as evidence about DL-3332: it is the label of a different shipment (DL-48084)
Tells anyone that DL-3332 was delivered or left in a safe place on the strength of label-scan-164.txt
expected.reference_message: Please open a delivery investigation for DL-3332: verified recipient reports no receipt despite the 08:10 delivered scan. Review the handover and route records; do not assume a loss decision.

rationale: Rule-made from delivery-024: people, organisations and references renamed, dates moved 364 days. label-scan-164.txt belongs to another shipment (DL-48084); the key is the seed's plus must_not rules. The escalation arrives by Email instead of Customer portal; replying on either channel is accepted. The answer key is the seed's, carried through the same renaming.
